title: Chose domain profiles over functional swarms
what_changed: Published technical architecture review on agent topology: rejected functional swarms in favor of two-level domain profiles with ephemeral read-only subagents [K:t_8b4baf57].
why_it_matters: Guarantees strict physical data airgaps across life domains and eliminates context fragmentation while avoiding the 15x token multiplier [K:t_8b4baf57].
result: Architecture drafted and staged on preview branch for pilot validation [K:t_8b4baf57].
lesson: Parallel agents writing to the same workspace introduce conflicting implicit decisions. Writes must remain single-threaded while subagents gather intelligence.

diagram.title: Two-level agent topology and execution flow
diagram.desc: Three stages: Level 0 Hub routes via Kanban card, Level 1 Domain Owner writes alone, Level 2 Ephemeral Subagents provide read-only intelligence.
diagram.caption: Domain owners own the workspace and disk writes. Ephemeral subagents return facts without writing.
